**Maintenance release: the trigger for SOA-converted users no longer depends on audit rules the toolkit does not own.**

SOA-converted users are onboarded by event 5136 (write to `msDS-ObjectSoa` by the Cloud Sync agent). In 2.0.0, `AuditConfig` accepted any existing, broader SACL rule as sufficient. If such a rule (for example a temporary diagnostic "Write all properties" SACL) was removed later, the event disappeared without notice, and these users were only picked up by the next reconcile run. 2.0.1 closes that gap. No change to the target state of users, the PSO or the enforcement policy.

## Changed

- **`AuditConfig` always sets the toolkit's own SACL entry** on every write-scope container: Everyone, *Success*, *WriteProperty* on `msDS-ObjectSoa`, descendant `user` objects. Broader rules of others are reported as INFO and are **never** relied upon.
- **`Uninstall-SoaToolkit.ps1 -Step RemoveAudit`** removes only SACL entries with the toolkit's exact fingerprint, and only on the containers recorded in the manifest.
- `Get-SoaAttributeGuid` reads from the DC the context is bound to (no PDC emulator dependency).

## New

- Monitor checks:
  - **`AUD-SACL`**: toolkit SACL entry present on every write-scope container (FAIL if missing).
  - **`AUD-SACL-OTHER`**: other rules that also audit these writes (INFO, e.g. diagnosis leftovers).

  Reading a SACL needs "Manage auditing and security log", which the toolkit gMSA deliberately does not have. The checks therefore run in `Watch-CloudUserConformance.ps1 -Scope All` and `Install-SoaToolkit.ps1 -Step Verify`. The scheduled monitor reports INFO.
- Module functions `Test-SoaSaclFingerprint`, `New-SoaSaclRule`, `Get-SoaSaclState`, shared by install, monitor and uninstall.
- Documentation: [how the toolkit identifies changes that cannot carry a marker](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.0.1/docs/SETUP.md#91-changes-that-cannot-carry-a-marker) (ACEs, SACL entries, domain setting, user attributes, ADMX files).

## Upgrade from 2.0.0

1. Replace the scripts with this release (keep your `SoaToolkit.config.psd1`; no new keys).
2. Add the toolkit SACL entry where only a broader rule existed, and update the scripts on the hosts:
   ```powershell
   .\Install-SoaToolkit.ps1 -Step AuditConfig, DeployTasks
   ```
3. Remove diagnostic SACLs that are no longer needed (`AuditConfig` and `AUD-SACL-OTHER` list them).
4. Verify. `AUD-SACL` must be PASS for every write-scope container:
   ```powershell
   .\Install-SoaToolkit.ps1 -Step Verify
   ```

Details: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.0.1/CHANGELOG.md) · [Setup guide](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.0.1/docs/SETUP.md) · [Operations](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.0.1/docs/OPERATIONS.md)

## Verify the download

Compare the SHA-256 of the downloaded asset with the digest GitHub shows next to the asset:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\cloudsync-soa-toolkit-2.0.1.zip -Algorithm SHA256
Get-ChildItem -Recurse | Unblock-File
```
